column1: # pm/title-fixes.tsv -- lane.local's record that a commit ANSWERS a failed gate of a title.
# dispatch_gate.py counts a fix for a PLAYABLE_ATTEMPT only from a row here (or from a commit that
# changes the title's own pathknow/paths/<TID>.json); a commit that is merely newer than the
# verdict is never a fix (fix:6cef37f426, an unrelated fold, admitted DOA3 on 10-06).
# Columns: title_id (8 hex) | gate: one or more of menu_time reached_gameplay duration static
# position void crash hang window_unmeasured hitch_unreadable, '+'-joined, or `route` for the first
# five | fix_commit (sha, 10+ hex) | set_by: lane.local or owner (any other value does not count)
# | date (PDT) | why: how this commit answers that gate for this title (required).
# A perf gate (fps, hitch, audio) row is recorded but admits no Playable attempt: the title needs a
# verdict after the fix that clears the bar, from a TELEMETRY or VALIDATION run.
